title: bug: report_blocked picks the architect to page by team.role only, but the launchers put every architect on the role-less project team, so every block escalates to the governors as "no live architect" and #architects has never received a block page
description:
Filed by defect hunt #16 (task-151a2c54, architect-2a219562) on 2026-11-04. Found by the lane-2 subagent; the holder re-ran the repro and re-read every cited line at b9205914.

PROBLEM
- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/workerLiveness.ts:69-78, findFreshestLiveWorkerByRole:
  - it collects only teams whose `role === 'architect'`;
  - it returns null when there are none (:73);
  - it counts a worker only when `worker.teamId` is one of those teams (:78).
  It has no id-prefix fallback.
- Its only caller is tools/reportBlocked.ts:405-417. A null result makes the mention prefix `@governors ` (:417), so the 🚧 page skips #architects and is addressed to the governors.
- The launchers deliberately give a team role to governors only: scripts/moe-agent.sh:2105-2114 and :2516-2520, and moe-agent.ps1:1783-1788 and :1970-1975. Their comment: "For architect/worker/qa we omit role ... The mention router falls back to a workerId-substring match ... when team.role isn't set."
- util/workerRole.ts:22-52 (resolveWorkerRole) calls a seat on a role-less team "not a rare edge". It resolves the team role first, then the id prefix (roleFromWorkerId). This selector is the one role lookup that skips that fallback.
- Contract: docs/MCP_SERVER.md, `### moe.report_blocked`, the Ping routing bullets (:1241-1242). The daemon direct-mentions the freshest live architect, "resolving the role through `worker.teamId`", and escalates to the governors only "with no live architect".
- Live state, read-only at 05:55Z: the "moes" team (team-a94dc136, role null) holds all 4 architects, 3 QA and 4 workers. The "Architects" team (team-ceeda973, role architect) has 0 members.

EVIDENCE
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-151a2c54/B/zzHuntB_reportBlockedRolelessArchitect.test.ts, with its .output.txt beside it. In a git archive of b9205914, run `cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/tools/zzHuntB_reportBlockedRolelessArchitect.test.ts`. It fails: it expects "architects: (mention of the architect) 🚧 worker-… blocked on task-1: …" and receives only "governors: (governors mention) 🚧 …". Its first assertion, that resolveWorkerRole gives 'architect' for the same seat, passes.
- Production (#governors, .moe/messages/chan-15c8e232.jsonl, counted by the holder): 148 system 🚧 block lines, 139 addressed to the governors group and 0 to an architect. #architects (chan-18116c9a.jsonl) has received none. Example: 2026-11-04T05:25:21.251Z "🚧 qa-58a8e460 blocked on task-87cba58c…" went to the governors 40 s after architect-2a219562's last activity (activity.log 05:24:40.817Z).

FIX DIRECTION
In findFreshestLiveWorkerByRole, match a worker when its team's role equals the role. When its team has no role, or it has no team or a missing team, match it when roleFromWorkerId(worker.id) equals the role. That is resolveWorkerRole's precedence: an explicit roled team still wins over the id. Keep the liveness window, the excluded ids and the tie-break as they are. Then sync the Ping routing wording in `### moe.report_blocked`.
- Hunk ownership in docs/MCP_SERVER.md: edit only the Ping routing bullets (:1241-1242). The Stale-block visibility bullet (:1237) belongs to the sibling stale-block row filed in the same hunt.

FILES
- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/workerLiveness.ts
- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/workerLiveness.test.ts
- packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/reportBlocked.test.ts
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md (### moe.report_blocked, Ping routing only)
Nothing here is held by an open row at 06:01Z.
definitionOfDone: A report_blocked on a task whose only live architect sits on a role-less team, with an architect- id prefix, direct-mentions that architect in #general and #architects, while #governors gets its unmentioned copy. This is proven by a new vitest case asserting the hunt repro's expectations.

New vitest cases in workerLiveness.test.ts pin the rest. A live seat on a roled team whose role is not architect is never picked, even with an architect- prefix. With no live architect, the ping still escalates to the governors. The existing workerLiveness and reportBlocked tests pass unchanged.
docs/MCP_SERVER.md's `### moe.report_blocked` Ping routing text states the team-role-then-id-prefix rule, and no other section of the file changes.

comments.content: Planning ruling (architect-c33f294e, 2026-11-04). The FIX DIRECTION also asks for the id-prefix fallback when a worker has no team or its team is missing, which is full resolveWorkerRole parity. That conflicts with DoD 2, which says the existing tests pass unchanged. Measured on a snapshot of 3500ae19, full parity fails exactly 2 existing cases in workerLiveness.test.ts: 'skips workers with no teamId or a teamId pointing at a missing team' and 'returns null when no team carries the requested role'. The DoD is human-owned, so the plan applies the fallback only to a seat whose team exists and has no role. That is the launcher shape DoD 1 names, and both cases stay byte-identical. A seat with no team, or whose team is missing, stays unpaged as it is today. That leftover gap has no production impact right now: every live architect, worker and QA seat sits on the role-less moes team (team-a94dc136). Full parity would be a separate row that rewrites those 2 cases on purpose. Also, the hunt repro's slice(0, 60) literals are mis-sized: 🚧 is two UTF-16 code units. They fail even with the fix, whose routing is correct, so the new case asserts anchored strings instead. Verified dry run: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-31a2aa2f/prototype.diff (+98/-6, all gates green, 4 new cases fail without the fix).
